Question.dc.html.title: Coming back — it asked a question

AddTasks.dc.html.title: Add tasks — write them or ask Claude

cGate.text:
GATE VIEW — components

Shell: three columns, each a shadcn ScrollArea.
Top band: Motion (AnimatePresence, slides down when a run needs you). Also set document.title + favicon dot so it shows from another tab.
Tree: Magic UI File Tree (project → feature file → task). Glyph + label from one <StateGlyph/> component.
Account chip: shadcn Badge, one variant per account.
Gate card: Magic UI Magic Card (cursor spotlight) inside Border Beam. Eyebrow: Animated Shiny Text. Enters with Blur Fade.
Plan: react-markdown + Tailwind typography, max-w-[68ch].
Files touched: shadcn Collapsible.
Reply: shadcn Textarea + outline Button. Approve: shadcn Button, rounded-full, size lg, with a ⌘↵ hint.
Run record: Magic UI Terminal frame; rows from TanStack Virtual (useVirtualizer + measureElement for expanded rows); only new rows animate in, like Animated List.
Right rail: phases = custom stepper; cost = Number Ticker; windows = Animated Circular Progress Bar ×2; Stop = Button + Tooltip.

cReturn.text:
COMING BACK — components

Band: same slot as the needs-you band, but calm indigo with "Nothing needs you".
Digest: Blur Fade card; the timeline is Magic UI Animated List (staggered).
Exit-code chips: shadcn Badge + ShieldCheck icon. They always print the code, never "looks good".
Edit row expanded: Magic UI Code Comparison.
Cost: Number Ticker, live.
Grinding notice: shadcn Alert in amber, slides in with Motion. A notice, never a modal; "Let it run" dismisses it.

cQuestion.text:
QUESTION ≠ GATE

No Border Beam, no Approve, no check icon, no black button.
The question is a speech bubble from the agent. The composer is a shadcn Textarea with Magic UI Shine Border while focused, and an indigo "Send answer" button with a send icon.
The copy says plainly that there is nothing to approve yet.
In the tree it is still "needs you" (orange). Only the centre changes shape.

cEmpty.text:
EMPTY — components

Background: Magic UI Dot Pattern with a radial mask.
Illustration: three small cards (repo → task file → task), floating with Motion, drawn in the app's own UI so it teaches the real model.
Steps: Blur Fade with a stagger.
One action: shadcn Button that opens the Add repository panel inline in the centre column. It is not a dialog, because the brief allows modals only for confirmations. In Play it links to that artboard.

cStates.text:
STATE SYSTEM

One <StateGlyph state=… /> plus <StateLabel/>. The shape carries the meaning and colour backs it up. The greyscale row on the sheet is the test.
Only needs-you pulses. Only running spins.

cManage.text:
MANAGING — components

All of these replace the centre column. No routes, no settings page, and dialogs only for confirmations.

Start / resume: Blur Fade card. Ceiling = shadcn Input. Start = Button, which becomes a spinner via Motion layout. The one-at-a-time guard is a shadcn Alert. The Tweaks panel switches between open, interrupted and busy.

Add tasks: shadcn Tabs (Ask Claude / Write them). The ask box is a Textarea with Shine Border. Drafts appear as an Animated List of Checkbox rows with editable text. The file change shows as a diff (Code Comparison, unified). The add button counts the checked drafts. Entry point: a "+ Add task" row at the end of each task file in the File Tree.

Account switch: click the account chip. A shadcn Popover lists the accounts as RadioGroup rows, each with its own Animated Circular Progress Bar. Choosing another account turns the popover into a confirmation before anything changes. Finish with a Sonner toast.

Project settings: one Card with sections. Account = RadioGroup cards. Test command = Input + "Run it now" with an exit-code Badge. Task files = list + Command (combobox) for adding. Remove from kantan = AlertDialog, the only modal.

Add repository: progressive form (Blur Fade per section). Path detection results appear as an Animated List. The right rail shows a live File Tree preview of what will be added.
